period_note: Unaudited consolidated quarterly financial statements. Balance sheet is the 30-Sep-2024 snapshot (reported). Like the 2025 H1 filing (see 2025_Q2.json), this specific report's P&L only prints a 2-column layout (9M'24 cumulative vs 9M'23 cumulative) with no discrete-quarter columns. Income-statement items below are therefore CALCULATED as 9M'24 (reported) minus H1'24 (reported, this dataset's own 2024_Q2.json cumulative figures) — the same method already used elsewhere in this dataset for deriving a discrete quarter from two genuine reported cumulative figures. MAJOR FINDING: the calculated discrete Q3 2024 shows a NET LOSS of -460,993,481 (PBT -1,413,832,211, offset by a large tax benefit of -952,838,730) — the first loss quarter for ALARABANK anywhere in this dataset's series (2010-2026), driven by a large provision expense (calculated at 3,181,137,336 for the quarter, versus ~537-891m in the other quarters on file) on top of continued net-investment-income compression.
